title: Lions 2025: Team News, Itoje & Daly Updates
text:
Morgan Shines as Lions Selection Battles Intensify Ahead of Waratahs Clash The pressure is mounting for players vying for a spot on the Lions’ Test squad, with standout performances like Jac Morgan’s now defining the selection landscape. A dominant display has propelled Morgan into contention, while others, including Tom Curry , face an increasingly uncertain path to selection.
A Rising Star and a Fallen Favorite Morgan delivered a performance of the “highest quality,” according to observers, showcasing “tremendous” energy, aggressive tackling, and skillful touches culminating in a crucial try. This surge in form has coincided with a downturn for Curry, who is now considered unlikely to secure a place in the starting 23 after being a near certainty earlier in the season. The competition is becoming “very cut-throat,” highlighting the high stakes for each player.
Front Row Friction and Unexpected Contenders The tighthead prop position remains a point of contention. Will Stuart failed to capitalize on his opportunity, committing multiple defensive errors and conceding three penalties – a performance described as “not the audition he wanted.” Surprisingly, Finlay Bealham , initially excluded from the squad, has emerged as a potential favorite for a Test spot, particularly with Tadhg Furlong yet to reach peak form.
Emerging Test Lineup Takes Shape Despite lingering uncertainty surrounding injuries, particularly regarding Daly’s fitness, a potential Test 23 is beginning to materialize. The projected lineup, as currently understood, is:
Kinghorn (Daly) Hansen Ringrose Tuipulotu Lowe Russell (F Smith) Gibson-Park (Mitchell) Genge (Schoeman) Sheehan (Cowan-Dickie) Bealham (Furlong) Itoje McCarthy Chessum (Beirne) Van der Flier Conan (Pollock) This potential squad is sure to spark debate among fans and analysts alike.
Swift Transition to Sydney The intensity of the selection process underscores the rapid pace of the tour. According to sources, the outcome of the Brisbane match will quickly fade into the background as coach Farrell announces the team to face the Waratahs on Thursday. The Lions must swiftly refocus, demonstrating their ability to move on from past results and prepare for the challenges ahead. The journey continues to Sydney, demanding unwavering focus and adaptability.
